final: WITH t AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS tp FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), a AS (SELECT AVG(tp) AS atp FROM t), k AS (SELECT name, tp FROM t, a WHERE tp > a.atp) SELECT (SELECT SUM(tp) FROM k) AS sum_total_points, (SELECT AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE r.name IN (SELECT name FROM k) AND res.laps IS NOT NULL AND res.laps <> '') AS avg_laps, (SELECT AVG(tp - a.atp) FROM k, a) AS avg_excess
